environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; thick, chunky bark textures with stylized resin drips; needles appear as soft, clustered tufts rather than sharp points; focus on the massive scale and verticality.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view looking up the trunk of a massive conifer. The dense canopy above chokes the light, creating a sense of ancient, sheltered depth.
visual_logic.ground: A thick carpet of fallen needles and charcoal-colored silt over a damp, heavy forest floor.
visual_logic.lighting: High-contrast backlighting from the upper canopy, emphasizing the silhouette of the branches.
